summary:
This is a stale re-validation at 8007d9f (build attempt 4). Since 3bd2b94 the tree changed in four places:
- two `-ExpectFacts['"]?\s*,\s*['"]?\d` lines in the SL-069 guard entries of .taad/fitness.yaml;
- `describe_not_run` in harness.py, which now single-quotes each name instead of printing a Python list repr;
- `Get-YamlName` plus C-007's reader in RuleCases.ps1;
- the sibling test's shapes.

RuleCases.ps1 outside C-007, eng/rules-parity.ps1, SettledCountProbe.ps1 and the acceptance repro are unchanged since validate-1.

**What I re-ran at HEAD (all exit 0):**
- **Parity on the real tree:** 11/15/27/49 under powershell.exe and pwsh.
- **C-001 and C-002 on the real tree:** pass under both hosts.
- **Sibling `-Shape All`:** 483 s, 187 ok rows, 0 FAIL rows. It covers GuardRule, with the pre-fix hits exactly 35,240,243,305,326,370,408,600,625,633, the argument-array `-ExpectFacts` spellings now caught, and the `$facts`/`$more` forms not caught. It also covers ExpectFactsMismatch ('found 11 … has 12' and 'found 12 … has 13'), HostParity with BOMs, and the remaining shapes.
- **ImportRuleNames with the real engine:** C-007 names 3 import rules NOT RUN, with 'unnamed: ' empty, under both shells.
- **C-007 on the real tree:** passes.
- **EngineCases (C-007 and C-008 on this tree and on a 12/17/28 copy):** passes in 338 s.
- **SettledCountProbe Misclassified:** passes.
- **Fitness op=check:** all 64 rules hold.

**Checks beyond the builder's:**
- I called `describe_not_run` directly from the worktree harness with an apostrophe name. Each name comes out single-quoted, and the old list repr would not have been.
- I ran C-007 itself on a copy whose test class has a data-driven [Theory] with three [InlineData] rows. Last time this was left open. Parity exits 2 with CANNOT-READ at [InlineData(1)], C-001 exits 1, and C-007 exits 1 because the harness reports CANNOT MEASURE with exit 2. So it fails loudly; it does not silently count trx rows past the source.
- My runs left 0 folders in %TEMP%.

**Still owed to build-slice: O-026 and O-027, both confirmed.**
- The engine's yaml.safe_load and Get-YamlName disagree on name 39 of 64 (the two-line plain name at fitness.yaml:504-505), which is O-026.
- On O-027's shapes the reader returns `'probe one' # a note`, `probe two # plain, with a note`, `>-`, `probe \"four\"` and `probe six wraps`. It also counts `must_not_import: []` as an import rule, which the engine does not run as one.

Both are latent. The only import rule in the real yaml ('the provider does not use the code it checks') is one line with no quotes or comment, and C-007 holds on it. They break no acceptance criterion today, so the verdict is passes.

**Loop shape.** Build attempts 3 and 4, and the lap O-026/O-027 now force, were all caused by code-review findings on one surface: the hand-written YAML name reader and harness quoting behind C-007. Each fix of the hand parser has exposed the next YAML spelling:
- O-025: apostrophes and repr;
- O-026 (m3): continuation lines;
- O-027 (R2-m4): comments, folded scalars, escapes and empty lists.

That is a loop around one design choice, not progress. O-027's fix, reading names through the engine's own yaml.safe_load, closes the whole class. O-026's line-folding fix and the declared escape follow-up are both subsumed by it. Building O-026 separately would be one more lap for nothing.

**Assumed acceptance.** The bug report is a title only. I took as acceptance the engine's repro (on record at exit 0, O-001, not re-run by me), the slice's two statements and the design's 14 cases. No block titled 'What this slice owes' was shown, so `planned` is empty and the design's cases are graded under `criteria`.

Latent today; C-007 holds on the real tree.
SettledCountProbe -Shape Misclassified exit 0 at HEAD (C-001 fails 4 checks on the stub, both shells).

not_reached: A real future slice declaring a twinned rule through the engine's own flow. Only scratch copies (and, in validate-1, replays of this repo's past rule states) were run.
A real import rule with a wrapped, commented, folded or escaped name. None exists, so O-026 and O-027 were measured only on the reader in isolation, not as a red C-007 on a correct harness run.

The harness-side mutant (describe_not_run reverted to {names}) and the old-reader mutant were not reproduced by this stage. The first rests on the builder's record; the second was refused by the engine's command guard.

Who created the ~837 fsa-parity-case-* folders (plus fsa-sl069-* and fsa-rules-*) in %TEMP% dated 09:00-13:59 today. My runs added 0 and normal completion measured 0, so they are most likely from killed or timed-out runs, possibly in other worktrees. They were left in place.
The acceptance repro was not re-run here by design; its exit 0 is the engine's measurement (O-001).
